evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence_status is MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS and fresh-within-2h=false.
No per-strategy, per-chain realized NET P&L distribution after all actual fee/slippage/reconciliation audits.
Lack of Solana real-time quote/preflight simulation integration in the market feature adapter, leaving all Solana strategies fail-closed at zero edge.
Substitution of expected edge for realized edge on fee-pending or BROADCAST rows in EVM live recording, obscuring execution failures and slippage.
Absence of disjoint chronological holdout validation in Strategy Lab's promotion logic to prove out-of-sample durability.

proposals.downside_risk: Increased Jupiter API traffic and latency. Rate limits or API timeouts may disrupt scanning if not handled with cached preflights or fail-closed fallbacks.

evidence.detail: Solana observations hardcode gross_edge_bps, fees, slippage, price_impact, liquidity_score, and sellability_score to zero, marking needs_quote_feature_adapter=True.

The solana_sibot module already implements a Jupiter quote client (jupiter_quote) and entry/exit validators (_validate_shadow_entry, evaluate_position) capable of real-time round-trip cost calculations.

proposals.expected_effect: Populates Solana MarketFeatures with realistic contemporaneous economics, enabling Solana copy-trading and market-native strategies to be properly evaluated on an economic basis.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 consecutive Solana leader observations with valid Jupiter quotes across 3+ days of evaluation.
proposals.rationale: Solana strategies are structurally fail-closed and unable to satisfy Strategy Lab's common eligibility filters. Reusing the existing jupiter_quote engine from solana_sibot to populate Solana features with real-time, quote-backed slippage and fee estimates resolves this gap.
proposals.shadow_test: Run a shadow cycle where market_feature_adapter queries jupiter_quote for WSOL->Asset and Asset->WSOL on every loaded Solana leader event. Populated features must yield non-zero fees and slippage scores. Set a fail-condition if API failure or rate-limiting causes more than 5% of cycles to fail or time out.

proposals.downside_risk: Delay in scorecard updates for slow/congested blocks, and potential data omission if a transaction is never reconciled.

evidence.detail: The recording loops on _EXECUTED_STATUSES (SUCCESS, SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING, BROADCAST) and falls back to expected_net_base when realised_net_base is absent.
Including BROADCAST rows means unconfirmed, pending transactions are recorded as successful trades using preflight estimates rather than final balance changes.

proposals.expected_effect: Enforces strict reconciliation before recording trade outcomes, ensuring that Strategy Lab scorecards reflect actual net wallet deltas and separate execution overhead from strategy performance.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 finalized EVM opportunities across multiple congestion levels without fallback expected-net substitutions.
proposals.rationale: Substituting expected preflight edge for realized edge on fee-pending or broadcast rows obscures execution failures, reverts, replacement gas costs, and actual slippage. This leads to artificial profitability figures in Strategy Lab.
proposals.shadow_test: Compare expected preflight edge to finalized wallet deltas on all SUCCESS/BROADCAST EVM transactions. Rejects must fail-close. Stop the evaluation if any unconfirmed or expected-fallback row contributes to promotion candidate status.

proposals.downside_risk: Strategies will spend significantly longer in SHADOW mode, and sparse strategies may take a long time to gather sufficient disjoint window samples.

evidence.detail: evaluate_strategy flags status='PROMOTION_CANDIDATE' based on MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS, MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES, and aggregate net P&L / profit factor, without split out-of-sample validation.

proposals.expected_effect: Ensures promoted strategies possess a robust, durable edge across distinct chronological periods, reducing the risk of drawdown or failure during canary live testing.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 3 chronologically distinct evaluation windows containing at least 5 completed trades each for every strategy family under review.
proposals.rationale: Evaluating a strategy on aggregate in-sample data is highly susceptible to overfitting to specific market regimes. Splitting the evaluation into chronologically disjoint out-of-sample windows ensures durability and prevents a single lucky window or outlier trade from causing premature promotion.
proposals.shadow_test: Implement a cross-validation script in Strategy Lab that divides the evaluation history into 3 disjoint chronological windows. A strategy is only promoted to PROMOTION_CANDIDATE if it is net-profitable and has a profit factor >= 1.10 in all 3 windows individually. Reject promotion if any single window is unprofitable.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote strategies based on aggregate raw win counts or simple win-rate percentages.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win rate is a misleading metric that ignores the magnitude of losses. A high win rate can still be net-unprofitable due to large drawdowns or execution costs, violating the money-weighted net P&L objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Bypass or loosen minimum liquidity and sellability score floors to increase Solana transaction frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana's rapid execution environment and high volatility mean that lowering liquidity or sellability gates directly exposes the bot to toxic flow, frontrunning, and permanent slippage loss.

rejected_ideas.idea: Estimate transaction fees using static averages rather than real-time gas/priority fees.
rejected_ideas.reason: Network congestion causes dramatic spikes in EVM gas prices and Solana priority fees. Static estimates would cause under-estimation of costs, resulting in fake-positive edge.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly prioritizes money-weighted net results and enforces strict risk controls, but holds critical structural gaps. Solana observations remain structurally fail-closed and ineligible due to lack of a real-time quote/simulation adapter, despite solana_sibot possessing a functional Jupiter client. EVM live recording conflates expected preflight returns with realized net P&L on broadcast or fee-pending rows, masking slippage and execution overhead. Strategy Lab's promotion engine lacks chronological out-of-sample holdout validation to protect against overfitting. No live readiness or profitability is supported without fresh runtime evidence.
